note: New strings of the canonical finance pages, used with inline English defaults. The wave merge must unwrap the `en.finance` wrapper and merge the children into the finance namespace (do not copy the wrapper). Translate for fr, rw, sw.

messages.paymentReverseFailed: The payment could not be reversed: {{error}}
messages.creditNoteDraft: Credit note {{number}} raised as a draft.
messages.creditNotePostFailed: The credit note could not be posted: {{error}}
messages.deleteSchedule: Delete this fee schedule and its fee lines? Posted invoices keep their own lines.
messages.reversePayment: Reverse this payment? A posted payment is never deleted; a reversal keeps the money on the books.
messages.selectLearner: Select the learner the payment belongs to.
messages.selectCreditNoteLearner: Select the learner the credit note belongs to.
messages.enterPaymentAmount: Enter the amount that was paid.
messages.selectInvoice: Select the invoice this payment pays.
messages.addInstallmentDate: Add at least one installment with a due date.
messages.postedPaymentFrozen: A posted payment's amount, date, channel and learner are frozen. To correct it, reverse the payment and record a new one.
messages.postedNoteFrozen: This note is {{status}}. The repository refuses any change to its number, date, amount, learner, invoice or reason; only a move to another posted state is possible.
messages.postedFineFrozen: This fine is posted. The repository refuses a change to its amount, learner or dates; raise a credit note to correct it.
messages.postedBalanceFrozen: This balance is posted. The repository refuses a change to its amount, learner or dates; raise a credit note to correct it.

feeSchedules.title: Fee Schedules
feeSchedules.description: A fee schedule fixes the fee items and exact amounts an academic year bills. An invoice copies the schedule's lines when the billing run posts it; editing a schedule later never changes an invoice that is already posted.
feeSchedules.billingPeriodsHelp: Leave empty to bill the whole academic year.
feeSchedules.levelsHelp: Leave empty to bill every level.
feeSchedules.emptyDescription: Create a fee schedule to define what a term bills.
feeSchedules.noLinesDescription: A schedule with no lines bills nothing.

studentPayments.title: Student payments
studentPayments.description: A payment is posted when it is recorded, so it can be reversed but never edited or deleted. The receipt number is issued with the payment.
studentPayments.emptyDescription: Record the first payment to start the collection history.

paymentAllocation.title: Payment allocation
paymentAllocation.description: A posted payment can be applied to any posted invoice of the same learner. The payment's allocations may never exceed the amount that was paid; the repository refuses the write when they would.
paymentAllocation.nothingOutstandingDescription: Every invoice of this learner is settled.
paymentAllocation.noAllocationsDescription: Allocate a payment to an invoice to start.
paymentAllocation.noOutstandingShort: This learner has no outstanding invoice.

feeAdjustments.title: Fee adjustments
feeAdjustments.description: A scholarship, discount or exemption is a credit note against the learner's fees. Meeting a posted invoice with a correction is this note, never an edit: the repository freezes a posted note and a posted invoice alike.
feeAdjustments.emptyDescription: Raise a credit note for a scholarship, discount or exemption.

fines.title: Fines and penalties
fines.description: A fine is a one-line posted charge against a learner. Once posted it is frozen: the page still offers Edit so the repository can refuse the write, and a credit note is the way to correct it.
fines.emptyDescription: Post a fine against a learner to start.

installmentsPage.title: Fee installments
installmentsPage.description: An installment plan splits a fee into dated percentages. A fee schedule line can name a plan; the plan itself carries no money, so it never drifts from the amount billed.
installmentsPage.emptyDescription: Create a plan to split a fee into dated installments.

openingBalancesPage.title: Opening balances
openingBalancesPage.description: A brought-forward balance is posted as an invoice whose single line has kind “opening_balance”. Once posted it is frozen; a credit note corrects it.
openingBalancesPage.emptyDescription: Post the balance a learner brings into this period.

collectionSummary.title: Fee collection summary
collectionSummary.description: Billed is every posted invoice line of the period; collected is the share of those lines the recorded payments have settled. Nothing is rounded on the way.
collectionSummary.nothingDescription: Run invoice generation for the period, then return to this summary.

paidBook.title: Students paid book
paidBook.noPaymentsDescription: Widen the dates or record a payment.
paidBook.searchPlaceholder: Learner, admission number, receipt or reference

feesDue.title: Fees due
feesDue.nothingDueDescription: Every posted invoice in scope is settled.

voteheadStatementPage.title: Votehead statement
voteheadStatementPage.noStatementsDescription: Post an invoice to give its lines a statement.

previousSessionPage.title: Previous session fees
previousSessionPage.description: Invoices from earlier academic years and what is still outstanding on them. A carry-over is written as an opening balance in the new session, not by editing the old invoice.
previousSessionPage.noFeesDescription: Invoices from earlier academic years will appear here.

dashboard.title: Finance dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Billing, collections and outstanding fees, read from the canonical finance documents.
dashboard.noRecentPayments: No payment has been recorded yet.
dashboard.outstandingMessage: {{count}} invoices still carry a balance; {{overdue}} are past their due date.
dashboard.noCreditNotes: No credit notes have been posted.
dashboard.creditNotesMessage: {{amount}} of posted credit notes reduce the billed total.

billingRun.description: Choose a period, preview the billing run, then post it. Each learner receives one posted invoice per period; a learner who is already billed is reported, never edited.
billingRun.compactDescription: Bill the published fee schedules of a period. Preview first; the run posts one invoice per learner.
billingRun.summary: {{action}} {{count}} invoice(s) for {{amount}}. {{skipped}} already billed, {{unmatched}} without a matching schedule.
